title: Run Twelve
summary: The climax at home (STORY.md §16). Starts after the Foundry and waits for the Clause: once lead ≥ 6, Meridian speaks (meridian-speaks, cine-meridian) and Trust decides. Severance and Inheritance end the game from here; the fight is ten minutes of strikes and turned units while the Gantry fuels the strike force, then the travel to the Lantern.

objectives.text: Keep the colony well. The report goes out at each sol's end
Hold until the strike force is ready

fails.text: The cryo bank has failed under the strikes.

notes: Its first objective is deliberately ordinary: doing well is what wakes the Clause. Title kept spoiler-free (GOALS shows it while it waits).
